evals.prompt: I want to build a text-to-SQL feature in my app using Spice and GPT-4o. Walk me through the workflow — from schema introspection to prompt construction to executing the generated SQL.
evals.expected_output: Full workflow: read spicepod.yaml, introspect schema with SHOW TABLES/COLUMNS, sample data, build prompt with dialect rules, call LLM, execute SQL with error retry

assertions.name: includes_dialect_rules
assertions.description: Should include DataFusion SQL dialect rules

assertions.name: shows_prompt_template
assertions.description: Should show how to construct the LLM prompt

assertions.name: includes_error_retry
assertions.description: Should include error retry with feedback pattern

evals.prompt: I'm trying to write a SQL query in Spice to get orders from the last 7 days but I keep getting cast errors with timestamps. The column is created_at. What's the right syntax?
evals.expected_output: Use now() - INTERVAL '7 days', explain DataFusion timestamps are Nanosecond precision, show CAST syntax

assertions.name: uses_interval_syntax
assertions.description: Should use INTERVAL syntax for date math

evals.prompt: How do I use vector_search and text_search together in a SQL query? I want hybrid search with RRF over my documents table.
evals.expected_output: Show rrf() wrapping vector_search and text_search, explain join_key parameter, note that spicepod.yaml must have embeddings and full_text_search configured

assertions.name: uses_vector_search
assertions.description: Should include vector_search in the hybrid query

assertions.name: uses_text_search
assertions.description: Should include text_search in the hybrid query
